lines.lyric_translation: It’s so strange, I never imagined at first
I thought you were just a good friend

lines.lyric: Nado moreuge jakku ni saenggagi na
lines.lyric_hangul: 나도 모르게 자꾸 니 생각이 나
lines.lyric_translation: But without knowing, I kept thinking of you
My cheeks grew red, I kept laughing

lines.lyric: Gamchul su eopshi keojin nae mam boyeojullae
lines.lyric_hangul: 감출 수 없이 커진 내 맘 보여줄래
lines.lyric_translation: I can’t hide it, I wanna show you my heart

lines.lyric: Neul hamkke isseo jweo nal dugo gaji ma Boy
lines.lyric_hangul: 늘 함께 있어줘 날 두고 가지마 boy
lines.lyric_translation: Always be with me, don’t leave me boy

lines.lyric: Ijen ara With my heart nan Only neo
lines.lyric_hangul: 이젠 알아 with my heart 난 only 너
lines.lyric_translation: You know now, with my heart, it’s only you

lines.lyric: Nae nuneul bwa Boy hateu gadeukajana
lines.lyric_hangul: 내 눈을 봐 boy 하트 가득하잖아
lines.lyric_translation: Look into my eyes, boy, it’s filled with hearts

lines.lyric: Nuga mweora haedo nan Only, only neo
lines.lyric_hangul: 누가 뭐라 해도 난 only, only 너
lines.lyric_translation: No matter what anyone says, it’s only, only you

lines.lyric: Nan O N L Y neoya Don’t ask why
lines.lyric_hangul: 난 O N L Y 너야 don't ask why
lines.lyric_translation: It’s O N L Y you, don’t ask why

lines.lyric: Jinjja sarangen da iyuga eomneun beop
lines.lyric_hangul: 진짜 사랑엔 다 이유가 없는 법
lines.lyric_translation: There’s no reason to true love

lines.lyric: Call me jelly bulleo jweo maeil
lines.lyric_translation: Call me jelly, call me that every day

lines.lyric: Uri dulmane Code seolleneun Love mode
lines.lyric_hangul: 우리 둘만의 code 설레는 love mode
lines.lyric_translation: It’s our own code, heart fluttering love mode

lines.lyric: Baby baby tell me eotteoke saenggakae
lines.lyric_hangul: Baby, baby, tell me 어떻게 생각해
lines.lyric_translation: Baby, baby, tell me, what do you think?

lines.lyric: Mweoga geuri bokjapae neodo nal weonhajanni
lines.lyric_hangul: 뭐가 그리 복잡해 너도 날 원하잖니
lines.lyric_translation: What’s holding you back? You want me too

lines.lyric_hangul: 아닌 척해도 넌 티나 티나 that's right
lines.lyric_translation: You can pretend not to but it’s so obvious, that’s right

lines.lyric: Ja iri wa Kiss me butterfly
lines.lyric_translation: Come here and kiss me, butterfly
Ooh, I tremble even when we slightly pass
Ooh, even when we slightly touch my heart goes

lines.lyric: Kongdak kongdak kongdak bunmyeonghae L O V E
lines.lyric_hangul: 콩닥, 콩닥, 콩닥 분명해 L O V E
lines.lyric_translation: Boom boom boom, it’s clear, L O V E

lines.lyric: Deo gidarigen haji ma nae dabeun hanaya
lines.lyric_hangul: 더 기다리겐 하지마 내 답은 하나야
lines.lyric_translation: Don’t make me wait any longer, my answer is only one
A tickling first love, feels like I could fly

lines.lyric: Nae soneul kkok jaba Never ever nochi ma
lines.lyric_hangul: 내 손을 꼭 잡아 never ever 놓지마
lines.lyric_translation: Hold tight to my hand, never ever let go

lines.lyric: Neowa na Against the world nan duryeopji ana
lines.lyric_hangul: 너와 나 against the world 난 두렵지 않아
lines.lyric_translation: You and me against the world, I’m not afraid
